name: Google Drive sync bootstrap
description: Initialize drive_sync_state after OAuth connect. Run per principal.

steps.name: Map sync state row
steps.script:
local after = input.backfill_after or "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = input.connection_id or "",
  root_folder_id = input.root_folder_id or "root",
  backfill_status = "pending",
  backfill_folder_queue = { input.root_folder_id or "root" },
  backfill_after = after,
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = input.poll_interval_seconds or 300,
}

root_folder_id.description: Drive folder to crawl; default root
